independently_discovered_opportunities: Unify fragmented external-dependency truth without inventing live state.
Correct the embedded receipt self-reference problem and bind the exact artifact before edits.

product_platform_improvements.problem: Billing, AI, database, email, repository, deployment, domain, health, and safety states were visible through separate records and could not be reviewed in one exact vocabulary.
product_platform_improvements.implementation: Added a protected owner-only unified live-operations register and API that classifies every dependency using the V14 state vocabulary, rejects unsupported VERIFIED_LIVE claims, separates five artifact/deployment identities, preserves closed safety gates, and supplies one exact protected owner action.
product_platform_improvements.before_state: Multiple valid owner views existed, but no single evidence-bound cross-service state register or one-action summary existed.
product_platform_improvements.after_state: One machine-readable and owner-readable central register shows contract-ready, owner-action-ready, blocked, and closed-by-design states without sensitive content or false live claims.
product_platform_improvements.benefit: Roger can see the exact next protected action and all remaining live blockers in one place while public non-AI functionality stays independent.
limitations: No exact repository, commit, Render deployment, provider secret, DNS/TLS, live smoke, portal compatibility, or stabilization evidence is available.

builder_prompt_system_improvements.problem: The prior release discipline did not encode V14 mode selection, exact pre-edit binding, or a final embedded owner receipt that avoids direct and indirect ZIP self-reference.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.implementation: Added the Mode B artifact-binding receipt, exact V14 packet preservation evidence, five-identity release contract, embedded OWNER_RECEIPT, separate payload inventory with explicit exclusions, and a validator that rejects outer-ZIP identity fields, stale or unsafe inventory entries, unsupported live states, and weakened closed gates.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.before_state: Noncircular candidate/final separation existed, but no V14 owner receipt/payload inventory standard or exact mode-binding receipt existed.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.after_state: Every packaged release can carry a truthful owner receipt and payload inventory while the final outer ZIP SHA-256 and size remain detached and reported after packaging.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.future_build_benefit: Future chats can establish the exact base and mode before edits, preserve completed work, and deliver receipts that never claim to contain their own final ZIP identity.
limitations: The final outer ZIP identity cannot be embedded and must be reported only after immutable packaging.

lessons_carried_forward: Exact artifact access must be proven before edits.

One owner action is more useful than a list of unranked external blockers.
